Work with us

We are looking for talent managers and recruiters — freelance, paid on results, working the roster you build.

The form is not live yet. Until it is, email tiktok@dcassociatesgroup.com with the details below and we will reply either way.
  • Your name, email, and TikTok handle
  • Whether you have managed or recruited creators before, and where
  • Roughly how many hours a week you can commit
  • The country and state you live in

What the work actually is

Talent manager. You look after a group of creators: help them build a schedule they can keep, get them set up to stream from a computer, pair them for head-to-head battles, and escalate problems — false strikes, bans, payment questions — on their behalf. The job is mostly consistency and follow-through, not sales.

Recruiter. You find creators who would be better off with support than without it, start a real conversation, and bring them in through TikTok's official invitation system. No cold-spam, no scraping, no bought lists — those break TikTok's rules and we will not run that way.

How you get paid

TikTok pays networks a monthly bonus based on how the roster performs. Managers earn a share of the bonus their own creators generate — so your pay tracks how well the people you look after actually do. We will give you the exact terms in writing before you start.

Creators keep one hundred percent of their diamonds. Your pay never comes out of a creator's earnings, and neither does ours. If you have worked somewhere that took a cut of gifts, this is not that.

The honest version

  • This is freelance, contractor work — not employment, no salary, no benefits
  • Pay is performance-based. A roster that does not stream earns nothing
  • We are a new network, so you would be building from a small base
  • You keep your own hours; nobody is tracking your screen
  • We will not ask you to pay anything to join — ever, for any reason
  • We will not ask for your TikTok password, and neither should anyone else
  • We will not promise you a number we cannot back up

What we need from you

  • 18 or older, and legally able to work as a contractor where you live
  • Located in the region our network covers — TikTok enforces this, not us
  • Reachable. Creators ask questions at odd hours and notice when nobody answers
  • Straight with people. You will be the reason someone trusts us or doesn't
How the hiring works. You send the form, we reply either way, and if it looks like a fit we talk. Anyone who takes on creators signs a written agreement first — scope, pay, confidentiality, and how either side ends it. Nothing starts on a handshake.
